title: This Lake Could Deliver a Deadly Radiation Dose in One Hour

scenes.text: A Russian lake once gave a deadly radiation dose in an hour.
It is Lake Karachay, next to the Mayak nuclear plant.
From 1951, the Soviets dumped nuclear waste into it.
In 1990, the shore measured about six hundred roentgens an hour.
That is enough to kill a person standing there in about an hour.
Workers later filled the lake with concrete blocks, rock and soil.
The last layer went on in 2016. A whole lake, buried.

description:
A lake in Russia once gave a deadly radiation dose in an hour.
Lake Karachay was a waste dump for a Soviet nuclear plant. In 1990 the shore reading was around 600 roentgens an hour. It has since been filled in and covered.
Have you ever heard of it?
thumbnail_text: A LAKE THAT KILLS IN AN HOUR
first_comment: Bonus: the lake was completely filled in and capped by 2016. What other place would you never visit?
